results.evidence: The Thirtymile line is 12.1 mi on the Chewuch Trail to the Four Point Creek split plus 4.3 mi to the summit, about 16.4 mi one way; another source gives 33.25 mi round trip with ~6,400 ft gain. So dist_km 25.7 (16 mi one-way) and '16+ miles one-way' are both correct, and '25+ miles' round trip is a lower bound that the ~32-33 mi Thirtymile trip (and the shorter Andrews Creek line) satisfy.

results.correct_value: Thirtymile Trailhead (Chewuch River Trail #510 to Remmel Lake)
results.evidence: The route description and a climbers-log entry for the 2011 ascent both approach from Remmel Lake, hiking in on the Chewuch; the Chewuch Trail from Thirtymile runs almost to Remmel Lake. So the waypoint (Thirtymile) is right and approach_logistics (Andrews Creek) looks wrong. But the TRAILHEAD card's own coordinates are Andrews Creek's, and pin positions are out of scope, so renaming it alone would create a name-vs-coordinate mismatch. Changing it needs a coordinate decision too.

Neither mentions Four Point Lake.

results.fact: Direction of the ridge from the gap to the summit
results.correct_value: From the gap, follow the ridge north-west to the summit; reverse south-east on descent
results.evidence: The peak's route description says its three main ridges run west, north and southeast from the summit, with the southeast ridge as the standard route, so going from a gap on that ridge to the top means travelling north-west. On the row, the summit pin lies north-west of the trailhead and SE-cirque tarn, approach_variants puts Point 8,280 north-west of the tarn with the summit half a mile further north-west, and 'turn left' after heading north up the scree also means west. Only 'south' (beta, pitch_detail) and 'north' (descent_text) disagree.
